videos.title: 50,000-Dollar Trap
videos.overview: Park Dong-hoon has a lot on his shoulders, including supporting a mother and two out-of-work brothers. One day, he receives a mysterious package.

videos.title: Survive
videos.overview: A misunderstanding causes Dong-hoon to be interrogated for bribery. Lee Ji-an is the only witness, but she has no interest in helping him out.

videos.title: Will You Hate Me, Please?
videos.overview: Ji-an plants a bug in Park Dong-un's office. Unaware of who she's working for, Dong-hoon agrees to buy her dinner for a month.

videos.title: A Diligent Lifer
videos.overview: Fearing Ji-an's recklessness, Do Jun-yeong does some digging of his own to find out who he's dealing with. Dong-hoon's brothers launch a new business.

videos.title: The Pay Phone
videos.overview: Ji-an taps Dong-hoon's phone. When she overhears that he's gotten a hold of Jun-yeong's phone records, she alerts corporate investigators.

videos.title: Betrayal
videos.overview: Kang Yun-hui advises Dong-hoon to quit his job and start his own business. Unfortunately for her, he knows exactly what she's trying to hide.

videos.title: Camping Site
videos.overview: Dong-hoon confronts Jun-yeong at a secluded campsite to put his scheming to an end. For a while, Jun-yeong seems to do as he's told.

videos.title: 30,000 Years Old
videos.overview: Lee Gwang-il watches from a distance as Ji-an warms up to Dong-hoon. Dong-hoon is offered a seat on the board, giving him the chance for revenge.

videos.title: The Envelope
videos.overview: Jun-yeong realizes that Ji-an could be his surest weapon. Dong-hoon's family gets ahead of themselves when they learn he could be promoted.

videos.title: The Slippers
videos.overview: Dong-hoon refuses to tell anyone the real cause of his injuries. Ji-an fully pays off her debt to keep Gwang-il from hurting anyone else.

videos.title: Out Of All, Why?
videos.overview: Before the interview, a few directors try to build Dong-hoon an airtight case, knowing his connection with Ji-an will be brought into question.

videos.title: I Wanted You To Be Happy
videos.overview: Upon hearing Yun-hui's side of things, Dong-hoon rethinks his priorities. Ji-an continues to make uncomfortable advances toward Dong-hoon.

videos.title: Can I Hug You?
videos.overview: Ji-an's testimony catches Dong-hoon's opponents off-guard. Dong-un comes close to catching those responsible for his misfortune.

videos.title: Would You Be Happy To See Me?
videos.overview: When Ji-an's past is exposed, she goes into hiding. Meanwhile, her recordings fall into the hands of those looking to make some money.

videos.title: Ji. An.
videos.overview: Jun-yeong may walk free due to a sorry lack of evidence. When Ji-an loses a loved one, Dong-hoon's brothers make sure she is not left alone.
